headline: Kapolri Jenderal Suyudi Commits To Eradicating Drug Trafficking
seoTitle: Kapolri Jenderal Suyudi on Drug Trafficking
metaDescription: Kapolri Jenderal Suyudi Ario Seto has identified drug trafficking as a critical national threat and pledged zero tolerance for police involvement.
aiSummaryBullets: Kapolri Jenderal Suyudi Ario Seto labeled narcotics as the mother of all crimes during a briefing.
The Chief of Police stated that drugs pose the greatest threat to Indonesia's youth in reaching the 2045 national vision.
Jenderal Suyudi pledged to dismiss any police officers found participating in narcotics distribution or usage.
aiContextParagraph: Kapolri Jenderal Suyudi Ario Seto has emphasized the urgent need to combat narcotics, identifying it as the root of many criminal activities in Indonesia. During reports to President Prabowo, Jenderal Suyudi highlighted that illicit substances are increasingly targeting young people through diverse methods, including vape products and laughing gas. Consequently, the Chief of Police announced a strict policy of zero tolerance, promising to remove any police personnel associated with drug networks regardless of their rank. These remarks occur amidst broader efforts to reform the national police force and improve institutional integrity. Previous reports indicate that the leadership of Jenderal Suyudi has received support from former Brimob commanders and has seen high levels of public approval regarding police institutional reforms and service responsiveness.
whyItIsViral: The topic is experiencing strong momentum with coverage across six independent outlets following the Chief of Police's high-profile remarks on drug enforcement.
